b: ^You are three months into the job.
^You are three months into the job as the first chief executive of the Tallowfield Integrated Care Authority, which started on 1 July.

root: ^Since July, most of the Authority's work has been on older people who keep coming back to the emergency department. A lot of the problem turned out to be in aged care, which the Authority doesn't fund and can't direct.

b: ^The Care Navigator Program, which the Authority inherited, was extended for twelve months while it is reviewed.

^The Care Navigator Program was extended for twelve months with an evaluation. The evaluators start next week, and Leila Karimi has already sent them a list of what the last evaluation didn't measure.
^The Care Navigator Program is halfway through its redesign. Tom Nguyen's practice is trialling the phone referral, and so far someone answers it.
^The navigators now work from Tallowfield Hospital. Referrals from the emergency department have doubled, and referrals from general practice have nearly stopped.
^The Care Navigator Program has closed and the discharge team is busy. The PHN's $1.6 million is still unallocated, and Priya Raman's letter is still on file.
^Dr Aldous has mentioned twice that the Minister's office wants to see results before the end of the year.
^Board members now ask for the evidence behind each recommendation, as you gave it in your first board paper.
^Priya Raman now sends one of her managers to most meetings with the Authority.
^Simon Rafferty has started ringing you before the LHD makes announcements.
^Not yet written, pending review by Aboriginal colleagues: a follow-up to the note you sent the Aboriginal Medical Service in your first week.

root: ^Dr Judith Aldous needs a one-page analysis of the region for the Authority's first quarterly report to the Minister's office. It's due on Friday.
^Ruth Okonkwo gives you the SWOT analysis that came over from the old partnership. The first strength listed is "strong stakeholder relationships". The first weakness is "limited resources".
^"Most of it could have been written about any region," she says. "The board will notice."
